excerpt: In this blogpost, we first review the landscape of Post-Quantum Cryptography implementations across some of the most popular cryptographic libraries. Following that, we present the results of a differential fuzzing campaign on few of the presented implementations.

author: Lucas Laise
excerpt: MyReport is a report generation software often used as a component of web-based applications. We describe a privilege escalation and remote code execution vulnerabilities in MyReport Updater 2.1.1 through its update configuration and gRPC service.
